page: Microsoft Azure D8alds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the Daldv6 family. It is equipped with 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical AMD EPYC 9V74 cores operating at 3.7 GHz. The system includes 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is supported by a 472 GB local disk, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. No GPU accelerators are present on this virtual machine.

Benchmark results show strong single-core performance, with stress-ng single-core CPU and Geekbench single-core scores placing in the top 25%. Text processing is a notable strength, ranking in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-core performance, memory bandwidth, and static web serving throughput fall within the average range. However, the low-memory configuration presents a tradeoff for memory-intensive tasks, as shown by weak prompt processing speeds on medium 7B LLM inference models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the D8alds_v6 offers a balanced profile for compute-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. The combination of dedicated AMD EPYC cores, high single-core performance, and local storage makes it suitable for web serving, text processing, software compilation, and moderate database operations. It is less suitable for large-scale data analytics or large language model inference due to its 2.0 GB per core memory limitation.
